content: Paperclip (81k stars MIT): orchestration control plane with tickets, org chart, budgets with hard stops, review/approval gates, watchdogs/recovery, MCP gateway, evals; its own E2E eval skill mandates: missing evidence must not produce a pass, passing model-authored tests cannot override the independent oracle, evidence-based attribution of startup/transport/timeout failures (product vs provider vs infra), retention of attempts/retries/source SHA/model/grader version/tokens/costs, secrets kept out of screenshots/logs/catalogs.
